device.description: 8-bit serial I/O SAR ADC with 4-channel multiplexer (single-ended or differential)
device.note: adc0832-n.pdf (SNAS531B) p.2 connection diagrams (Figures 1-7), p.3 operating ratings, p.5 digital and DC characteristics, p.6 AC characteristics (fCLK, tC, tSET-UP, tHOLD, tpd, t1H/t0H), p.9-11 timing diagrams (Figures 15-21), p.13-14 MUX addressing (Tables 1-7), p.15-16 the digital interface

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the last MUX address word after the start bit (no read-back; cleared while CS is high per p.16, reset 0 here)

commands.name: Start bit + MUX address
commands.note: Figure 20 / Tables 4-5: start bit 1, SGL/DIF, ODD/SIGN, SELECT1 on CLK rising edges 1-4 (leading zeros ignored). Capture a = ODD/SIGN,SELECT1: 00 CH0, 01 CH2, 10 CH1, 11 CH3 (the + input; differential pairs CH0/CH1, CH2/CH3). Reply from falling edge 4: the MUX-settling zero, D7..D0 MSB first, then D1..D7 LSB first (D0 shared), then DO low until CS rises

commands.name: Leading zero (no start bit)
commands.note: p.15: the start bit is the first logic 1 on DI after CS falls; all leading zeros are ignored

pages: p.2 (Figure 3 NPA pinout), p.3 (operating ratings: VCC 4.5-6.3 V), p.5 (TTL input levels, TRI-STATE output), p.6 (AC: fCLK 10-400 kHz, tC 8 clocks, tSET-UP 250 ns, tHOLD 90 ns, tpd 1500/600 ns, t1H/t0H 250 ns), p.9 (Figures 15-16), p.10 (Figure 20), p.14 (Tables 4-5), p.15-16 (digital interface steps 1-9)
notModeled: analog inputs, multiplexer, single-ended / differential selection and VREF span (stored only; the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)

DI is ignored after the MUX address until CS rises (p.15-16); the model's stream frame keeps matching DI, so a 1 on DI during the output restarts the reply. Hold DI low after the address; the one-wire DI/DO tie (p.16) is not supported
DO is TRI-STATE from CS fall until the MUX-settling clock; the model shifts z for at most 32 leading clocks before a start bit
SARS: high from the MUX-settling half clock to the end of the 8-clock conversion and TRI-STATE while CS is high; with the clocked conversion (time 0) the model only drives it low
the conversion is clocked by CLK (8 clock periods after the MUX settling clock); not timed, the result is the 0 V code at once
fCLK 10-400 kHz, 40-60 % duty cycle, tSET-UP 250 ns / tHOLD 90 ns; tpd is 1500 ns max MSB-first and 600 ns LSB-first (the model uses 1500 ns for every bit)
all internal registers are cleared while CS is high; a new conversion needs a CS high-to-low transition
V+ shunt regulator (zener) input and the V+ / VCC diode
codeFormat: straight binary for a single-ended or positive differential input; a negative differential input reads 0x00
variants: ADC0831/0832/0834/0838 share the datasheet: 1, 2, 4 and 8 channels; ADC0832 (not in the skeleton) has the 2-bit MUX word and VREF tied to VCC internally. The PDIP (P/N) and PLCC (FN) packages are obsolete / not in the skeleton.
